message:
## Vulnerability Digest

No new vulnerabilities credibly matching the monitored product list were found in the last 24 hours. The review window was 2026-08-06 23:40 UTC through 2026-08-07 23:40 UTC (2026-08-07 05:10 IST through 2026-08-08 05:10 IST).

Searches covered vendor advisories, public CVE records, CERT/CISA material, GitHub security advisories, and reputable security reporting. Candidate reports were excluded when they were outside the window, could not be tied confidently to a monitored product, duplicated an older disclosure, or lacked credible verification. In particular, the Cisco IMC issue affecting UCS C-Series M7/M8 servers (CVE-2026-20200) was first disclosed on August 5 and therefore is not reported as new in this digest.

No immediate review is recommended based on newly reported issues in this monitoring window. Continue normal patching and inventory review for previously disclosed vulnerabilities.
